preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of operations is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the tree.
Each operation specifies two distinct nodes within the tree.
The given graph is an undirected tree.

postconditions.expression: ci is the number of integers j (1 ≤ j ≤ n; j ≠ i) such that the lists of the i-th and the j-th nodes contain at least one common number.
postconditions.description: The output for each node i is the count of distinct integers j (where j ≠ i) that share at least one number with node i's list.
